And various refinements

notes.title: Major Overhaul
notes.content:
A complete overhaul from sound to animations, and everything in between.

[list]
[*] Falling too far or taking too much damage can cause the player to ragdoll
[*] The player can ragdoll at will with a hidden key.
[*] When taking damage the player now has a physical reaction.
[*] Some 3d models have been remade or replaced with high poly versions.
[*] Many objects now play sounds when the character is close to them.
[*] The ground floor has new animated textures.
[*] Most cosmetics have improved textures.
[*] Game physics has been reworked.
[*] Just lightly taping the jump button now results in a smaller jump.
[*] Fixed many vaulting bugs.
[*] Charged gravity spell now has sounds and particle effects when used.
[*] Jump pads now have sounds and particle effects when used.
[*] Powerups now have sounds and particle effects when received. 
[*] High jumps now have their own animation.
[*] While doing a double jump the player may do a flip.
[*] Falling now has a few more animations.
[*] Wall-run is easier to activate and has a slight up force attached to it.
[*] Wall-run animations have completely been redone.
[*] Swinging animations have completely been redone.
[*] Leaving world bounds instant jibs you now.
[*] And many other small changes that improve the look and feel of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE: Step UP!
notes.content:
Grab the ledge, you idiot! ːsteammockingː

One of the biggest frustrations in platformers, including my own, is the tendency for characters to fall even if they make contact with a ledge. As a kid, I used to yell at the screen, telling my character they could have just reached out and grabbed the ledge.

So, in my game, I decided to fix this issue. Now, if your character is close enough to a ledge and not too low when you hit the jump button, they will reach out and pull themselves up.

While this tweak does make the game easier, it also adds a smoother and more satisfying gameplay experience. So, grab that ledge, and don't fall all the way back down!

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Fix some audio bugs and added a LeonHeart studios splash screen.

There are also some minor changes to the tutorials making it so that if the player changes the default key bindings they will properly show the new key bindings.

Not much else at the moment :)

Though if you encounter a bug or have a suggestion I would love to hear about it. You can post in the community discussion boards or on my discord https://discord.gg/YFWBz9e2 or email me directly at DanielLeonheart@gmail.com. 
While I can add a few more achievements there is not much else for me to do until I get feedback so I am all ears.

LordMaddog
